final_candidates.decision_summary: Highest AlphaMissense pathogenicity (0.987) in the pool with low MSA tolerance (P frequency 0.077); Pro in a helical region should break secondary structure and abolish activity.
Pathogenicity 0.962 with full MSA coverage showing zero Tyr tolerance at a conserved catalytic-loop cysteine — strong dual evidence for loss of function.
Phenotype score 0.977 strongly pathogenic; proline at this highly sensitive Arg site should disrupt backbone beyond the known damaging R357C (0.829).

stop_reason.detail: Top-3 is stable and further evidence rounds are unlikely to change the ranking.

history.rationale: Glu429Ala is a well-established MTHFR polymorphism associated with reduced enzyme activity and thermolability. Loss of the charged side chain at this conserved position destabilizes the FAD-binding region.
AlphaMissense classifies E429A as benign (0.082) and ESM-1v finds it fairly plausible, strongly contradicting loss-of-function despite its clinical fame as a mild thermolabile variant.

rejection.reason: AlphaMissense classifies E429A as benign (0.082) and ESM-1v finds it fairly plausible, strongly contradicting loss-of-function despite its clinical fame as a mild thermolabile variant.

history.rationale: Ala222Val is the classic thermolabile MTHFR variant causing substantially decreased activity in vivo. Substitution perturbs local packing near the FAD/NADPH-binding domain.
Pathogenic-class prediction (0.632) and low ESM-1v plausibility support loss of function; retained as rank 2 pending MSA evidence.
Mild thermolabile variant with only 0.632 pathogenicity and plausible-by-ESM; insufficient for abolishing activity, demoted below Top-3.
Arg357Cys is a reported pathogenic MTHFR missense variant associated with severe enzyme deficiency. Cysteine disrupts a conserved charged interaction.
Highest AlphaMissense pathogenicity (0.829, pathogenic class) and lowest ESM-1v plausibility, consistent with a strongly damaging substitution; promoted to rank 1.
Well-supported damaging variant (0.829) but now outscored by three newer candidates; retained as backup.
Since Arg357 is highly sensitive (R357C strongly damaging), a proline at the same site should disrupt local backbone even more; needs phenotype/MSA confirmation next round.
Phenotype 0.977 strongly pathogenic; MSA shows modest P tolerance (0.09) with only moderate coverage, slightly reducing confidence versus C243Y.
Conserved cysteine in the catalytic loop region; substitution to bulky Tyr likely disrupts structure/function — to be tested with phenotype tool next round.
Pathogenic prediction 0.962 with full MSA coverage showing zero Y tolerance at a conserved cysteine — strong combined evidence for loss of function.
Helical-region Leu-to-Pro substitution designed to break secondary structure and impair folding; to be validated with phenotype/MSA next round.
Highest AlphaMissense pathogenicity (0.987) of the pool; low MSA tolerance (P frequency 0.077) is consistent with disruption despite moderate coverage.
